english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for deliberately paying attention to sounds or speech.

examples.english: Listen—do you hear anything at the door?
examples.jyutping: nei5 teng1 haa5 mun4 hau2 jau5 mou5 seng1

english.note: Use this when “mind” means heed or obey what a person says or instructs.

examples.english: We need to mind what the teacher says.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 teng1 lou5 si1 ge3 waa6
